description: This file defines data structures (TypedDict classes) used for integrating with PagerDuty in a monitoring or alerting system. It includes classes for request payloads, alert configurations, and internal event metadata.

classes.name: LinkDict
classes.description: TypedDict for link details, such as href and optional text.

classes.name: ImageDict
classes.description: TypedDict for image details, including source src, optional hyperlink href, and alt text.

classes.name: PagerDutyPayload
classes.description: TypedDict representing the payload data sent to PagerDuty, including severity, source, and custom details.

classes.name: PagerDutyRequestBody
classes.description: TypedDict for the full request body to trigger PagerDuty alerts, including routing key, event action, links, images, and payload.

classes.name: AlertingConfig
classes.description: Configuration for alerting thresholds, such as failure counts and hanging request metrics.

classes.name: PagerDutyInternalEvent
classes.description: Data structure to hold internal event info, including timestamp, failure type, and optional error info.
